# Drag & Drop lists every example a visitor can drag

## Context

Drag & Drop is a top-level group of the examples list without records of its own: it is a curated cross-list, filled through `alsoIn` on records that live elsewhere. #21140's target takes it from two entries to ten. On `dev` `78013b10fc` it shows three: `multi-window-drag-drop`, `dialog-drag-drop` and `dock-tear-out`.

## The Problem

Since the target was written the engine's examples gained more than a dozen that are about dragging: a day re-planned by drag, tasks linked by drag, columns and cards rearranged, tabs reordered, a list reordered, tree items moved between folders. A visitor who opens Drag & Drop to check that claim sees three cards, all of them about windows and dialogs.

## The Architectural Reality

- `alsoIn` on a record lists it in a second group (#21141); the group page reads it, nothing else changes.
- The target names: the three it has, `tree`, `tab/container`, the choreography, the dock example (now the operations desk), `calendar/basic`, the sortable dashboard, the reordered list and the Sprint Board.
- On `dev` these also exist and drag is their subject: `scheduler/dragAndResize`, `gantt/dependencies`, `board/multiSelect`, `board/columns`, `tab/browser`, `list/reorder`.

## The Fix

Add `'drag-drop'` to `alsoIn` on every published record whose example a visitor can drag as its point, in an order that leads with the strongest (a re-planned day, a board, linked tasks, then tabs, lists and trees, then the windows). The sortable dashboard (#21886), the tree tile (#21884) and the file explorer (#21885) carry it in their own records when they land. A record joins only if its first frame or its one named action is a drag.

**State & Data's cross-list rides the same pass** (added 22 Nov from the row sweep of the target): its row says the simulated server and the streamed load "show here from Grid & Table", and on `dev` `78013b10fc` `grid-server-side` lists only `buttons` and `grid-streaming` lists nothing. Both get `'state'` in `alsoIn`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Drag & Drop shows at least ten entries on the pull request's head, and each one's caption or `lookFor` names a drag.
- [ ] The order is set on purpose and stated in the pull request.
- [ ] State & Data shows the simulated server and the streamed load as cross-listed cards.
- [ ] The catalog's specs pass.
- [ ] The look: the Drag & Drop page at 1440×900 and 390×844 in Neo Dark, before and after, on the pull request, read cold by the reviewer's seat.

## Out of Scope

New examples. Home records for this group. A change to how `alsoIn` renders.

## Avoided Traps

- **Every example with a draggable splitter.** The list is curated: an entry is here because dragging is what it shows.
